definitions.explanation: A rug or small carpet laid on part of a floor. Common in furniture shops and interior design.
A delay between two things that should happen together, as in online games, video calls or a time difference. Often in the compound タイムラグ.

examples.japanese: {冬用|ふゆよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a rug for winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧ラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{感|かん}じ→感じ：02555_kanji⟧になった。
examples.english: Putting a round rug in front of the sofa made the room feel brighter.

⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ラグ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: I lost the game because of network lag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}して→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧タイムラグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a bit of a time lag between ordering and the item arriving.

notes:
Two unrelated loanwords that share the same katakana spelling: "rug" and "lag". Context makes it clear which is meant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to lay a rug
- ラグマット: a rug, a mat (a common shop term)
- タイムラグ: a time lag
- ラグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: there is lag / the lag is bad (games, calls)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絨毯|じゅうたん}→絨毯：04497_juutan⟧, ⟦カーペット→カーペット：24239_kaapetto⟧: carpet — usually larger, covering more of the floor
- ⟦{時差|じさ}→時差：03075_jisa⟧: time difference (between time zones)
